entrenched across the Texas Panhandle and New Mexico, and even 
strengthens some into Friday. Therefore, expect continued high 
temperatures in the 97-103 range for Wednesday/Thursday and a 
nudge upward to 98-104 on Friday. We will likely have to extend

possibly expand it to additional counties in Central Texas. An 
Extreme Heat Warning may even be needed for parts of North Texas 
on Thursday and especially on Friday as heat index readings peak 
in the 110-115 range. This appears more likely on Friday as low
